In this video, we explore the 35 lakh crore Indian outsourcing industry, and how the rise of Global Capability Centers (GCCs) is reshaping high-value work. From basic BPO work to the core R&D of global giants like Google and Microsoft, we breakdown the evolution of the industry, the 9 lakh crore opportunity, and the 30 lakh high-paying jobs they will create. Stay tuned for insights into why GCCs are moving to non-metro cities and the risks posed by AI and geopolitics.
